restrictions: The two messages have 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^32: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block, compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t, v13 = 0), flags 3 and its true block length; the 63-byte block ends in eight zero bytes. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests (Lemma TR). Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision of two distinct complete messages.

This package (v110) is leech1996's v109 with step CO in the lanes restricted to the 64 lines of the closure of Y9 and w8 (counted 263 instead of 319 per batch; walk 322) and the other 13 lines computed only in passing steps (ctr_rest, REST_UNITS = 84 inside X). v109 is v108 (winglock's dd91b2f6 with the walk in seven 36-bit lanes) with H2'' resting on the exact mean of X under the model of H1' for Y4, Y9 and w8 (proof.md 9.4; experiment pass-mean), the cap 2^31 above X_MAX, the class count program printed in full (Section 17) and the checks of 9.4 printed (Section 18). dd91b2f6 is Jbenisek's 47804be2 (75.42) with the class without rule A, the exact E3 solver, margin 1.400 (GordoAR) and its accounting. Credited (proof.md 16): winglock, Jbenisek, Subflatus3, GordoAR, tekkac, Th0rgal, 5kyguy; none reviewed this package.

Exact part: for every outer step and c1 the two last-chunk chaining values agree on words 0, 2, 5, 7 (Theorem C); an outer step whose mask (conditions (1)_j on Y9 and (2)_j on omega = Y3 + y + w8, Section 8.3) lacks outcome j holds no trial with R = 0 and outcome j (Lemma F); the solver returns exactly the words E3.h1 whose E3 of both messages has outcome j's differences (Lemma E3; the cap 2^31 is never reached, so the scan of Lemma SC never runs); a returned word gives R = 0 iff its c1 (Lemma IP) is in Q*, t != 0 and E1 has (beta*, tau_j, eps) (Lemma G). So every listed good trial of a walked outer step is found unless the budget halts the run.

Heuristic part: RUN_OUTER_STEPS = 767,186,645,459,980,621,344 = 2^69.378 outer steps of 2^21 cube members (2^90.378 walked trials) succeed with probability at least 0.39 under H1' (rate at least 104,884,563,382 * 2^-128 per valid trial, the model count 2^11 * 71,698,432 divided by 1.4, and weak dependence inside an outer step) and H2'' (the mean of the pass units X of one uniform outer step at most 1369/16; exactly 84.20546 under the model, proof.md 9.4). No full collision is exhibited and none was computed.

256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, 64 registers, constants and shifts as instruction fields, one unit per operation, load, store, comparison, branch and random word. Counted by the program (v110): per batch of seven outer steps, 263 for the eight random words, the lanes, e1, y and the 64 lines of step CO in the closure of Y9 and w8 in the lanes (Lemma L7), 56 for the filter and the loop 3: 322 per batch, 46 per outer step; a passing step adds REST_UNITS = 84 to X for the other 13 lines (34 extraction + 50 counted). Lane dispatch and extraction (40 per passing step) are inside Lemma U. The solver is charged per event (call 546, guess 199, root 5, pop 13, internal node 14, child 11, push 11, leaf 49, good word 128; dispatch 56 + 84 per passing step; scan 2^21 * 192); the program's count of the solver equals these units plus the bookkeeping, which Lemma U bounds by X/15.

Time bound for every value of the coins: the run halts when its count of pass units exceeds PASS_BUDGET = ceil(RUN_OUTER_STEPS * 1369/16 * 6001/6000) = 2^75.797, so the count stays below PASS_BUDGET + X_MAX (X_MAX = 1,572,227,848, one step's maximum) and the pass work, bookkeeping included, below 16/15 of that (Lemma U); tables once below 2^38 machine units (the mask tables T1 and T2 included); the final step below 2^38 units; preprocessing 2^54.20 units charged in full. T = ((RUN_OUTER_STEPS / 7) * 322 + (16/15)(PASS_BUDGET + X_MAX) + 2^38)/430 + 2^38 + (116 * 2^56 + 116 * (2^52 + 2^10) + 2^51)/430 = 2^67.7310657, claimed 67.73107 (2^6773106 < T^100000 < 2^6773107 in exact integers, checked by the self-test).

The premise of H2'' (v109): under the law that the model of H1' gives Y4, Y9 and w8, the mean of X is exactly 11,850,864,922,893,441 / 2^47 = 84.20546 (v110; 83.75160 without ctr_rest's 84 units) (proof.md 9.4, Lemma PX; experiment pass-mean computes it for the organizer); PASS_PREMISE = 1369/16 = 85.5625 is 1.0161 times it. winglock's preregistered participant sample of v107 (proof.md 13.5; its programs and records are not public) measured a mean of 83.73906 over 2^35 real outer steps, the pass share at 0.99996 of the exact 2^-7.531997, and the E3 side of a success: 1,799 E3-good words against 1,897.0 under the model (0.948).

Preprocessing: steps 1 and 2 of the selection procedure of 47804be2 (116 solver runs at cap 2^56; the counter on each model at cap 2^52, which outputs the constants, eta, the solver's beta* = 18b0e098 and the outcomes of beta* in the class) and our development below 2^51 operations: below 2^62.95 primitive word operations (each run halts at its cap, counted as in proof.md Section 11). No sub-class, rule or ranking of betas is stored or selected. Memory below 2^44 bytes (two messages below 2^42 each, the search with the mask tables below 2^38.01). Advice 112 bytes: six constants and eta, beta* and its cube, fourteen tau and eps, the class mask and value, the part 71,698,432.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. Over the run's RUN_OUTER_STEPS independent uniform outer steps (drawn in lanes of fresh uniform 256-bit words, proof.md 9.1), let N_o be the number of listed good trials of one outer step (valid trials, t != 0, with R = 0 and an E1 outcome among the fourteen outcomes of beta* in the class, proof.md 10.1). (i) E[N_o] >= (2^21 - 1) q with q = 104,884,563,382 * 2^-128, the model's conditional rate 2^11 * 71,698,432 * 2^-128 divided by 1.4 (margin 1.400) and rounded down. (ii) rho = E[N_o (N_o - 1)] / E[N_o] <= 0.0065. Under (i) and (ii), by Lemma S8, the probability that no valid trial of the run is a listed good trial is at most exp(-0.99675 * 0.495910) < 0.6099993.
heuristics.scope: Exactly the trials of proof.md Sections 8 and 9: lengths 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 with a non-root last chunk (counter t, v13 = 0, flags 3), the six constants of Section 3.2, Y4 uniform in the class of eta = 830303cf (2^19 members, the 19 free bits of e1 from the outer step's lane of a fresh random word), E1.c1 in the cube of beta* = 18b0e098 in every trial, t solved per trial and t = 0 dropped, the seven outer words from the run's fresh 256-bit words.
heuristics.extrapolation: From an exact count under the seven-word model: the part of beta* in the class is 71,698,432 = sum over the fourteen outcomes of L_j N3_j / 2^83 (Jbenisek's counting program of proof.md Section 17 run on the class, which enumerates every outcome; v109 prints the class version in full with the output of our run in the pinned image; winglock's own counter gave the same fourteen rows), times 2^11 for the cube (Lemma S1), divided by 1.4. Participant evidence, untrusted by the harness: on 2^35 real outer steps of the class the E3 side of a success occurred 1,799 times against 1,897.0 under the model (0.948; 13.5); on 2^38 real counter trials the listed E1 outcome occurred 82 times against 79.5 (1.03; 13.6); Jbenisek's evidence on the sub-class (13.3): partial events within about 1%, the listed E1 outcome at 0.979 +- 0.022 in passing outer steps, and a reduced-width end-to-end run with complete messages, 251 collisions against 255.0 predicted. The joint 2^-91 event is not measured at 32 bits. For (ii) (13.7): on 2^33.58 real outer steps no step had more than two E3-good words (620 steps, 53 with two); conditioned on a success at each of the 673 words, with the words joining E1 to E3 drawn under the model (44,105,728 draws), the partner word had c1 in Q* 881,396 times and a second success never, so rho is estimated at 0 and below 0.00015 per word.
heuristics.limitations: The factor is assumed: the exact model count divided by 1.4 (GordoAR's margin, 6a600434 and 3f8e4e89, and ours in d598fe29, all plausible_not_refuted; 47804be2 and its predecessors divide by 2). RUN_OUTER_STEPS is minimal, so a real rate below 0.714 of the model's puts the success bound below 0.39. Against it: our measured E3 side is 0.948 of the model (2.2 standard errors below 1 if Poisson); in our d598fe29 a real-trial check of a different arrangement had ratio 0.82 +- 0.13. The joint rate of the E1 and E3 sides is the model's independence, not a measurement. The transfer of the single-trial law to the sampler is partly proved (Lemmas S2 to S4) and partly assumed in (i); no triangular order makes the E3 or E1 words free (13.7). For (ii) Lemma S7's cap assumed rule A and the sub-class and does not apply; the measurement of 13.7 draws the joining words under the model, so their joint law inside a real outer step remains assumed. Taken together the measured sides give 0.977 of the model with a standard error of about 0.11 (Poisson), 2.4 standard errors above 0.714. How much success mass the member with t = 0 carries is not bounded.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. For X, the pass units (proof.md 9.2: 0 for a step that fails the filter; otherwise the dispatch, the solver's events and its good words; the cap 2^31 exceeds the bound X_MAX = 1,572,227,848 of every X, so no scan runs) of one outer step drawn as in step 1 of 9.1, E[X] <= PASS_PREMISE = 1369/16 = 85.5625 machine units; the outer steps of a run are independent draws of it. Given it, the pass units of a run exceed PASS_BUDGET = ceil(RUN_OUTER_STEPS * 1369/16 * 6001/6000) with probability below exp(-579,845) (Bernstein over the independent outer steps, X in [0, 1,572,227,848]). Reaching the budget halts the run with failure; the time bound charges the budget in full.
heuristics.scope: The walk of proof.md Section 9.1 over RUN_OUTER_STEPS uniform outer steps with Y4 in the class: the filter of the fourteen outcomes and, in passing steps, the solver of Section 8.4 (its cap lies above X_MAX, so the scan never runs).
heuristics.extrapolation: From an exact computation (proof.md 9.4, Lemma PX). X depends on Y4, Y9 and w8 alone. Under the law that the seven-word model of H1' gives these three words (Y4 uniform in the class, Y9 and w8 uniform, all independent), its mean is exactly 11,850,864,922,893,441 / 2^47 = 84.20546 (v110, with ctr_rest's 84 units in a passing step). The computation is a forward and backward pass over the 32 bit levels of the solver's walk in rational arithmetic (experiments/passmean.py, run by the organizer as experiment pass-mean, about one second). The premise is 1.0161 times this mean. Checks (proof.md Section 18, programs printed): with every bit fixed the computation equals the walk's node counts on 68 calls (28 planted, 40 random); with nine bits uniform it equals the walk's average over 512 calls in 12 tests; on 840,000 real outer steps of v109's program (pinned image, three runs; v110 changes only the batch's lines and adds the constant 84 to X) every call's events equal the walk's (5,658 calls), and X equals the event formula on every passing step (4,415). winglock's preregistered participant sample (proof.md 13.5; programs not public) has mean 83.73906 over 2^35 real outer steps, 0.30 standard errors below the exact model mean of that X (83.75160, without ctr_rest).
heuristics.limitations: The model law of (Y4, Y9, w8) is not proved for the walk's outer steps: Y9 and w8 are outputs of step CO, and no triangular order makes them free words with Y4 (proof.md 13.8). H2'' is that the real law gives X a mean within 1.61 per cent of the exact model mean. The real-step evidence for that transfer is: the filter's pass share (0.99996 of the exact share on winglock's 2^35 steps; 0.9728 on our 840,000 real steps of Section 18, 1.83 standard errors below); the exact equality of the program's events with the computed walk on real calls; and winglock's sample mean (a participant report). X has a long tail (largest 4,967,706 in winglock's sample). The exact computation includes the tail under the model; no organizer-scale sample could. The organizer experiment computes the model mean and does not walk real outer steps. The time bound does not depend on H2''. With any premise up to 350.83 (4.17 times the model mean) the total stays below 2^69.3452 (proof.md 11).
